-- Update Full Package order with shipping cost
UPDATE fullPackageOrders 
SET shippingCostUsd = '25.00',
    profitUsd = ((sellingPriceUsd - purchasePriceUsd) * quantity - 25.00),
    status = 'delivered'
WHERE orderCode = 'FP-PROFIT-TEST-001';

-- Update Purchase Request order with shipping cost  
UPDATE fullPackageOrders 
SET shippingCostUsd = '15.00',
    profitUsd = -15.00,
    status = 'delivered'
WHERE orderCode = 'PR-PROFIT-TEST-002';

-- Update Commission order with shipping cost
UPDATE fullPackageOrders 
SET shippingCostUsd = '30.00',
    profitUsd = -30.00,
    status = 'delivered'
WHERE orderCode = 'COM-PROFIT-TEST-003';

-- Verify results
SELECT 
  orderCode,
  orderType,
  CAST(COALESCE(purchasePriceUsd, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as purchasePrice,
  CAST(COALESCE(sellingPriceUsd, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as sellingPrice,
  CAST(COALESCE(itemPriceUsd, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as itemPrice,
  CAST(COALESCE(commissionFeeUsd, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as commission,
  quantity,
  CAST(COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as shippingCost,
  CAST(COALESCE(profitUsd, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as actualProfit,
  CASE 
    WHEN orderType = 'full_package' THEN CAST(((sellingPriceUsd - purchasePriceUsd) * quantity - COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
    WHEN orderType = 'purchase_request' THEN CAST(-COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
    WHEN orderType = 'commission' THEN CAST(-COALESCE(shippingCostUsd, 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2))
  END as expectedProfit,
  status
FROM fullPackageOrders 
WHERE orderCode IN ('FP-PROFIT-TEST-001', 'PR-PROFIT-TEST-002', 'COM-PROFIT-TEST-003')
ORDER BY orderCode;
